This weapon amplifier has been adjusted to increase its energy emission system. Omegaton Industries gave the task to the engineers at Peul Forosixi Design who were assigned to find a way to fine-tune the product without actually replacing any original components. The new configuration was then implemented into the production to create an adjusted series, which were later replaced by a new official Omegaton version.  This version uses a similar configuration as its standard setting but was never as well tuned as the original adjusted version made by Peul Forosixi Design.

The chief-engineer at Omegaton Industries, Gainax Gray, was put in charge of the group assigned to improve the standard amplifiers for the imperial forces special ranger assault teams. The development group had to adapt and equip a standard model with new improved components to create a version with enhanced energy transformers. Although successful the new improved version was rejected by the imperial forces for still being inadequate to their needs. Instead the manufactured units of this special series were shipped to Calypso and sold off on the open market to whoever could afford them, making this quite a rare amplifier.

The organized covert construction-group, known as the Illuminox, created this very rare modified version of the Omegaton Amplifier. Standard components were replaced with new hyper-energy transformers and fitted within the same frame, a proof of the amazing knowledge and craftsmanship of the Illuminox. The members of the Illuminox are unknown but their function is clear. Their purpose is to cast new light upon human science, improving our technology while themselves remaining in the shadows of existence. The Illuminox take great pride in their work and are well informed about all new technological advancements on any world within known space. The number of different pieces of equipment that appear with their signature on it show a wide area of expertise, which strongly suggests that there must be more than just one member of the Illuminox present on Calypso
